apps.localizedDescription:
Apotris for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Play Apotris — a fast, feature-packed block-stacking game — natively on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro. Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, Dig, Blitz, Zen and more, with the responsive controls and deep customization the game is known for. 100% vibe coded with lots of passion and attention to detail.

Built on Apotris by akouzoukos, running natively through Metal — no emulator, the game's own engine rebuilt for Apple platforms.

iPhone / iPad — gestures (default). The whole screen is the surface:

• Drag left/right to move · drag down to soft drop · flick down to hard drop.
• Tap the right / left half to rotate CW / CCW · two-finger tap for 180°.
• Swipe up to hold · long-press for Zone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Now built on Apotris v4.2.0:

• Sonic Drop — a new option under Settings › Handling that makes the hard drop button drop the piece without locking it.
• Better online play — multiplayer can now fall back to a relay when a direct connection between players isn't possible, which should help on mobile data and strict Wi-Fi. Connecting is more robust in general, and you can queue for a match in the background while you play something else.
• If the server can't be reached, you now get a clear error and return to the menu after about 20 seconds, instead of waiting indefinitely.
• Fixes — Death mode record ranking and level display, multiplayer room code entry and match result stats, a crash when stopping a song, and assorted menu and sprite fixes.

Touch controls:

• Swipe in from the left edge of the screen to go Back in menus, like the rest of iOS. Two-finger tap and long-press still go Back too, and swiping in the middle of the screen still changes values.
• The pause button only appears during a game. It used to sit on the title screen and menus, where it did nothing.

Note:

• A game suspended in 1.1.10 can't be continued after updating; the saved-game format changed with the new upstream version. Scores, settings and stats are unaffected.
